description: Fetch bilateral trade flow records — the primary data retrieval tool. Returns trade value in USD (primaryValue — FOB for exports, CIF for imports), quantity, net weight, and period/commodity/partner metadata for each row. Accepts multiple periods and commodity codes per call; pass partner_code 0 to get totals aggregated across all partners. Omit cmd_code or pass "TOTAL" to aggregate all commodities. Free-tier capped at 500 records per call. Use comtrade_lookup_countries to resolve reporter/partner codes and comtrade_search_commodities to resolve HS codes before calling this tool.

classification.description: HS classification version. "HS" covers the combined dataset.

cmd_code.description: HS commodity codes to query. Maximum 20 codes per call. Pass ["TOTAL"] or omit to aggregate all commodities. Use comtrade_search_commodities to find the right codes.

flow_code.description: Trade flow direction: M=imports, X=exports, RX=re-exports, RM=re-imports.

partner_code.description: M49 code of the trade partner. Use 0 to aggregate across all partners (World total). Omit to get a disaggregated breakdown by partner country.

period.description: One or more periods to query. Annual: "YYYY" (e.g. ["2022", "2023"]). Monthly: "YYYYMM" (e.g. ["202201", "202202"]). Maximum 12 periods per call.

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country. Use comtrade_lookup_countries to resolve names to codes.

name: comtrade_get_trade_flows

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no records are returned. Absent on successful responses.

items.description: A single bilateral trade flow record.

flowCode.description: Trade flow: M=import, X=export, RX=re-export, RM=re-import.

isReported.description: True if directly reported; false if estimated or aggregated by UN.

netWgt.description: Net weight in kg. Often null for aggregated rows.

period.description: Period (YYYY for annual, YYYYMM for monthly).

primaryValue.description: Primary trade value in USD (FOB for exports, CIF for imports).

qty.description: Quantity in commodity-specific units. Often null for aggregated rows.

shown.description: Number of records returned in this response.

totalCount.description: Total matching records reported by the API.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at 500 (public preview endpoint limit).

truncationHint.description: How to get more data when truncated — requires a subscription key.

title: Get Trade Flow Records
